quotes.name: Clarissa Dane
quotes.quote: I've felt that my reputation as a District Attorney has been under scrutiny lately, and I'm not sure what to make of it. As someone who's dedicated to serving this community, it's concerning to think that my actions might be perceived in a way that undermines my work. I'm trying to stay focused on doing what's right for Fruitvale, regardless of what others might be saying.

quotes.name: Rick Walker
quotes.quote: I haven't really thought about how Clarissa Dane's episode affected her reputation, to be honest I'm more focused on my work as a line cook and what's going on in Fruitvale.

quotes.name: Rafael Pilgrim
quotes.quote: I've seen how people around Fruitvale talk about Clarissa Dane, and it seems like her episode has really changed how they think of her, I'm not sure what to make of it myself but it's definitely a topic of conversation.

quotes.name: Tomas Renteria
quotes.quote: I've seen how people in Fruitvale talk about Clarissa Dane's episode and it seems like it's had a big impact on how they think of her, I feel like it's changed the way people perceive her reputation.
